title: Medusa Selfie
description: A female figure with green scaled skin, horns, and elaborate purple and green snakes for hair holds a smartphone while taking a selfie. One snake extends from her hair to bite or interact with the phone screen as another snake on the right holds a dripping pink heart.
prompt: A beautiful female gorgon with green scaled skin, black horns, and long flowing purple snakes with green heads for hair, wearing an ornate green and gold armored corset with chains. She holds a smartphone in one hand taking a selfie, one snake from her hair bites the phone, another snake holds a dripping pink heart. Vibrant purple and green swirling background with floating hearts, detailed fantasy digital painting style.
